description: This file contains shell script code for testing Git fetch negotiation, including functions for tracing fetch output, checking sent and not sent commits, and multiple test cases for different fetch scenarios involving skipping commits, ref filtering, clock skew, and protocol versions.

methods.name: have_sent
methods.description: Checks if specific commits have been sent during fetch by grepping trace output.

methods.name: have_not_sent
methods.description: Checks if specific commits have not been sent during fetch.

methods.name: trace_fetch
methods.description: Runs a git fetch command with tracing enabled, using a custom upload-pack script to trace packet output.
